One clearly adult female heritage dancer, her facial appearance guided only by the attached portrait reference, is caught midway through lighting the final brass lamp before a carved stone gateway. She wears a fully opaque indigo silk sari ensemble: high-neck blouse, fitted underlayer, draped panels, and ankle bells. Her head inclines away from the vertical axis; her torso and hip deflect across the central axis; one bent knee returns the lower line; three alternating bends remain readable from head to feet, forming a clear tribhanga. Her spine stays axially elongated while both shoulders rest low and relaxed; her weight-bearing foot is planted as the other lower leg extends behind in a continuous plantar-flexed line through a pointed foot. Both feet remain unobstructed within spacious head-to-feet vertical framing. A waist-height front three-quarter 50mm view keeps the pose geometry legible without foreshortening. Rain-reflected fill keeps the indigo pleats and carved pillars legible beneath the torch highlights. Amber flames and rain haze recede through the deep colonnade.
